name: color-field
title: Color field
description: A hex color typed with a live swatch; a malformed value stays as typed with an example of a valid one.

when: Typing a known color in compact settings.

instead.when: People need to pick a color by eye.
A fixed set of colors is enough.

keyboard.does: Steps the value (the channel, on a single-channel field).

builtIn: A malformed hex says what a valid one looks like.
Required fields show "Fill in this field."

genui.description: A hex color input with a swatch. Emits change with the hex or null.
